sentence: I went to the woods because I wished to live deliberately, to front only the essential facts of life, and see if I could not learn what it had to teach, and not, when I came to die, discover that I had not lived.

source.author: Henry David Thoreau
source.detail: 第二章 "Where I Lived, and What I Lived For"

translation: 我走进森林，是因为我想从容、有意识地生活，只去面对生活中最本质的东西，看看自己能否学到生活要教给我的道理，免得到了临终之时，才发现自己从未真正活过。
grammar: 主干是 I went to the woods，后面是 because 引导的原因状语从句。从句核心是 I wished to…，后接一串并列不定式：to live deliberately、(to) front only the essential facts of life、(to) see if…、and not (to) discover…，后面几个 to 省略。否定不定式的 not 放在 to do 前面（not to discover），而不是 to not。
when I came to die 中 come to do 意为“到了……的时候”。discover that I had not lived 用过去完成时：站在“临终”这个过去时间点往回看，“没有活过”发生在它之前，是过去完成时最典型的用法。

vocab.meaning: 有意识地、从容审慎地（不只是“故意”）
面对、直面（较古典，现代多用 confront）

vocab.example: Sleep is essential for good health.

vocab.meaning: 逐渐、终于开始做某事；到了做某事的时候
vocab.example: I came to realize that practice matters more than talent.
